headline: US sanctions target 14 Nicaraguan gold entities and individuals
summary: The US sanctioned seven Nicaraguan gold companies and seven individuals, including two sons of the country's co-presidents, impacting international banks and precious metals buyers.
why: Gold is one of Nicaragua's primary export earners, and US sanctions restrict dollar-clearing access and global trade for affected domestic producers.

impacts.name: Nicaraguan Mining Sector
impacts.why: US sanctions bar seven domestic gold companies from US banking channels and commercial trade.
